tests.name: Windows CI lane manifest is deterministic

criteria.requirement: Results are deterministic and reproducible; all failures are explicit and actionable.
criteria.reason: Determinism of the Windows lane depends on the GitHub Actions runner image; CI run history is the evidence, not a repository test.

criteria.requirement: No secrets, personal data or raw screenshots in logs/artifacts; no unapproved network egress.

tests.name: Windows CI lane manifest is least privilege and pinned

criteria.requirement: Backwards compatibility and cross-platform behavior reviewed; no unsupported capability falsely advertised.
criteria.reason: Cross-platform compatibility review requires maintainers to validate supported platform behavior.
